in_sanskrit.name: प्रस्पर्श
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The act of touching, contact, feeling, or sensation. It can also refer to the sensation of touch, or the feeling of being in contact with something.

in_hindi.name: सपर्श
in_hindi.long_meaning: Seven + Taste. This name is derived from the ancient Indian concept of the seven tastes, or rasas, which are sweet, sour, salty, bitter, astringent, pungent, and savory.

in_tamil.name: சபர்சம்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The act of touching, contact, feeling, or sensation. It can also refer to the sensation of touch, or the feeling of being in contact with something.

in_telugu.name: శపర్శ
in_telugu.long_meaning: Six + Ashuddhi. This name is derived from the ancient Indian concept of six internal enemies, or ashuddhis, which are ignorance, attachment, anger, greed, pride, and jealousy.

in_marathi.name: Sparsh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sparsh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The sensation of touch or feeling, the connection or exploration of something.

in_bengali.name: Sparsh
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Touch, Feel
in_bengali.long_meaning: Sparsh একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The sensation of touch or feeling, the connection or exploration of something.
